name: Live chat paid message
oneLiner: a glass live-stream chat scrolls fast beside the live player, then a paid message in the brand colour band posts at the bottom, lifts, rides up to the top and pins with a badge while the chat keeps racing underneath
say: when the speaker talks about going live or a viewer paying to be heard ('someone sent fifty dollars in chat', 'the live stream blew up'): the chat races under the setup, the paid message lands and pins on the money line
